title: First public release
notes: 282 cell lines corrected with DepMap WGS copy number; significance from a label-permutation null, which replaced the normal-approximation null after it failed calibration.

title: Copy-number-expanded panel: 386 cell lines
notes: Adds 104 cell lines made copy-number-correctable by whole-exome copy number (Cell Model Passports WES 91, DepMap WES 13). v1 samples normalize identically and 97% of v1 calls reappear. Loci with no quantified signal (124, outside the fixed grid) are no longer scored.
